messages:
Maria Chen: Postmortem follow-up: incident with chat streaming (timeouts + partial responses). We need clear owners, timelines, and a plan for recurring pattern detection. TL;DR: 4 action items — reconnect/backoff tuning (runtime), client SDK bug (client), telemetry for partial-responses (observability), and canary rollouts for latency regressions (reliability). Please claim tasks and add ETA. :eyes:

Alex Park: I'll take reconnect/backoff tuning. Plan: adjust exponential backoff, hard cap on inflight streaming requests per connection, add jitter. Target: PR by EOD + canary deploy next week. ETA: 2026-03-30. I'll add config snippet for testing.

Alex Park: ```yaml
streaming:
  backoff:
    base_ms: 200
    max_ms: 5000
    factor: 2.0
    jitter: true
  max_inflight_per_conn: 8
``` 

Jamal Ortiz: I'll own SDK fix for partial-response detection and retry semantics. Issue: client treats final chunk w/o EOS as ok. I'll add an explicit heartbeat/keepalive check and unit tests. ETA: branch by 2026-03-29, release 2026-03-31. Will coordinate with Alex on backoff parameters.

Sophie Patel: Observability — I'll add a metric 'streaming.partial_response' + a trace tag when reconnect occurs. Also will create a dashboard and an alert if >0.5% of streams have partial_response in 10m window. ETA: dashboard by 2026-03-31, alerting by 2026-04-02.

Oncall SRE: FYI logs from 2026-03-25 03:12 UTC show client disconnects with 'RST_STREAM' spike. Snippet: ```log
[03:12:14] conn=xyz RST_STREAM code=2 downstream_timeout
[03:12:15] conn=xyz partial_response no-eos
```

DeployBot: Deployment scheduled: canary for backoff changes on cluster 'us-west-2' at 2026-03-30T02:00Z. :shipit:

Maria Chen: Good. Add owners to the postmortem doc and set up weekly check-in for two weeks. Also set customer communication owner?

Jamal Ortiz: I'll draft the customer note and share with legal for review. ETA 2026-04-01.

Sophie Patel: I'll run the regression eval harness against the canary and post results.

Alex Park: Will coordinate rollout policy: start 5% traffic -> 25% -> 100% with rollback on >1% partial_response. I'll add to Redwood Console rollout config.

Oncall SRE: Assigning rotation follow-up: I'll add this incident to the recurring pattern board and tag 'streaming-timeouts' for historical analysis.

Maria Chen: Thanks team. Summary: owners: Alex(backoff), Jamal(SDK + customer comm), Sophie(observability), Oncall SRE(ops tracking). Milestones: PRs + canary 2026-03-30, dashboards by 2026-03-31, customer note 2026-04-01. I'll update postmortem and ping in #incidents next week. :calendar:

Sophie Patel: :thumbsup:
